name: Heriot-Watt University - Malaysia

programmes.name: Computing Science
programmes.about: Software development and algorithms for building robust, usable systems, with an industrial training period between Years 2 and 3.
programmes.overview: Years 1 and 2 cover computer science, IT and mathematics, including software development, data structures, databases and software engineering. Year 3 has specialised units, three electives and a year-long dissertation. An industrial training programme sits between Years 2 and 3. Go Global allows transfer to the UK or Dubai campus.
programmes.ib: 26 points for 6 subjects including 5 in HL Maths AA or AI. Also grade C in SPM/IGCSE Additional Maths, or C in Maths plus a science, technology or engineering subject.
programmes.selectionNote: Offers are grade-based; the page says individual offers may vary. English: IELTS 6.0, none below 5.5.

programmes.name: Statistical Data Science
programmes.about: Modern statistics, modelling and analysing real data for economy, industry and research.
programmes.overview: The programme blends theoretical and applied statistics, training students to model, analyse and interpret real data for use in the economy, industry and research. The page lists three years on campus with September and January starts.
programmes.ib: 28 points for 6 subjects including 6 in HL Analysis and Approaches Maths.
programmes.selectionNote: Offers are grade-based; the page says individual offers may vary. English: IELTS 6.0, none below 5.5.

flagshipSource.title: BSc (Hons) Statistical Data Science: Malaysia campus

programmes.name: Psychology
programmes.about: The scientific study of mind and behaviour across biological, cognitive, developmental and social psychology and research methods.
programmes.overview: The programme covers the core domains of psychology: biological, cognitive, developmental, individual differences, social, conceptual and historical issues, and research methods. Teaching emphasises applying these to an inclusive and productive society. It starts in September or January.
programmes.ib: 25 points for 6 subjects. Also grade C in Maths and Science at SPM/IGCSE, waivable with a higher-level pass.
programmes.selectionNote: Offers are grade-based; the page says individual offers may vary. English: IELTS 6.0, none below 5.5.

summary: Scottish university's purpose-built lakeside campus in Putrajaya, with three-year honours degrees in computing, statistics, psychology and business.

ib.text: IB Diploma minimums are set per degree: Psychology 25 points, Computing Science 26 with HL5 Maths, Statistical Data Science 28 with HL6 Maths AA. Course Results alone are not addressed. Check each page.

languageOfInstruction.note: Each programme page requires IELTS 6.0 (no score below 5.5) or equivalent, and MPU national-language modules are optional extras.

faculties.name: Computing and statistics
faculties.line: Computing Science, Information Systems with Data Analytics and Statistical Data Science, all three-year BSc degrees.

faculties.name: Business
faculties.line: MA and BBA degrees in business, finance, accounting and marketing appear in the 2026/27 fee table; programme pages were not read.

faculties.name: Engineering
faculties.line: MEng degrees in civil, chemical, electrical, mechanical and robotic engineering appear in the fee table; durations were not checked.

notes: No 2027 application or closing dates are published. The Apply page says applications are accepted all year round and shows only a 2026 intake calendar; its scholarship and visa dates for 2026 are not rolled forward.
The academic calendar lists an undergraduate Welcome Week of 11-15 January 2027 for the January 2027 intake. A September 2027 date is not published.
IB Diploma entry points differ by programme; only three of the BSc degrees were read. Business and engineering degrees were not checked, and MEng degrees may run longer than three years.
English: IELTS 6.0 with no score below 5.5, or an equivalent, on the three pages read. Proof of English must be uploaded with the application.
Fees: the 2026/27 table lists annual international tuition of RM 51,304 (Computing Science), RM 55,035.20 (Statistical Data Science) and RM 51,007.20 (Psychology). 2027/28 fees are not published.

Costs on the Apply page: RM 530 non-refundable application fee for international applicants, a RM 3,900 visa application fee (one year; all countries except Indonesia) and a personal bond set by Education Malaysia.
Computing Science students can transfer to the UK or Dubai campus under Go Global; that is optional and separate from the Malaysia degree.
